meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档变成带 kawaii 风格的 PDF 幻灯片：检查登录、创建 Notebook 并添加文档，后台生成 16:9 的 PDF 存到源文件旁，配置齐全时还会上传生成 9:16 手机分享链接。
howto.when: 当用户说“Wowerpoint 某文件”“Make a slide deck about 某文件”“Turn this report into slides”等，或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.note: Claude 会为它生成一套 kawaii 幻灯片并给链接。

say.text: 把 sales.md 做成幻灯片
say.note: 触发相同流程，输出 PDF。
按可爱风格生成幻灯片。

howto.what_en: Turns a single document into a kawaii-styled PDF slide deck: checks login, creates a Notebook and adds the source, generates a 16:9 PDF next to the source file, and when configured uploads it to produce a 9:16 mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "Wowerpoint <file>", "Make a slide deck about <file>", "Turn this report into slides", or similar requests to render a document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Generates a kawaii deck and share link.
Runs the same flow and outputs a PDF.
